title: 第7章 出发前的宴会第8章 崩坏列车
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 银辉城，王家鸢尾花庄园。
宴会厅里，水晶灯照着酒杯和宾客的华服。空气中飘着食物的香气，也夹杂着生意场上的味道。
瑟薇娅端着酒杯，穿梭在人群里，脸上挂着完美的笑容。
“马尔斯会长，北境的矿产价值，比财政部那份旧报告高得多。再加上洛加里斯教授的新冶炼技术，回报能翻多少，您心里有数。”
瑟薇娅对一个身体发福的男人说道，那是靠倒卖魔导零件发家的新商人。
马尔斯会长的脸颊微微发抖。
“殿下您尽管吩咐！您的事业，就是我们这些商人的未来！资金不是问题！”
瑟薇娅点点头，转身走向一个年轻贵族。
“安德鲁，我知道你的顾虑。”
“我父亲，还有我那两位好哥哥看不上的地方，正是我能扎根的地方。”
安德鲁是少数支持瑟薇娅的新派贵族，他眉头紧锁：“殿下，北境和王都不同，老公爵的那些旧部下，恐怕……”
“我知道。”瑟薇娅打断了他的话，“所以我才需要你们。”
她的声音不大，安德鲁却瞬间站直了身体，目光也变得不一样了。
“殿下！”一个穿白袍的身影悄无声息的出现在她身边。
是奥萝拉。
“怎么，圣女殿下也对我们凡人的俗事有兴趣？”瑟薇娅开了个玩笑。
奥萝拉脸上挂着圣洁的微笑，说出的话却很实在：“教廷元老院那边，我已经帮你打点过了。但是，审判军自成一系，不归我管，你要小心。”
瑟薇娅明白了。
“多谢。”
“我们之间，不用说这些。”奥萝拉将一杯果汁递给她。
瑟薇娅正要再问，一个魁梧的将军已经大步走了过来。
北境军团前任副统帅，铁岩将军。
“公主殿下！”将军的嗓门很大，“您要去北境开创大业，怎么能把我这个老家伙丢在王都！”
“将军说笑了，您是王国的柱石，我可请不动您。”
“殿下可别这么说！”铁岩将军一脸兴奋，“我听说了，洛加里斯教授设计的第三代魔导甲，已经配发给了您的卫队！那玩意儿，我可是馋了很久了！一拳就能把巨魔的脑袋砸进它自己的胸腔里！太够劲了！”
他搓着手，样子不像个高级将领，倒像个看见新玩具的孩子。
“只要殿下能让我摸摸那套新盔甲，别说北境，就是刀山火海，我老铁也跟您闯了！”
瑟薇娅笑了。
洛加里斯那个家伙，总能在这些想不到的地方，给她带来一些惊喜。
就在这时，宴会厅的音乐声被门口一声高亢的通报打断了。
“二皇子殿下驾前，菲利普子爵到——！奉二皇子殿下之命，为即将远赴北境的瑟薇娅公主殿下献礼！”
这声通报让整个宴会厅瞬间安静下来。所有人的目光都投向了门口。
一个脸上涂粉、穿着紫色礼服的年轻男人走了进来，摇着一把镶宝石的扇子。正是二皇子身边最受宠的弄臣，菲利普子爵。他身后还跟着两名侍从，毕恭毕敬地捧着一个盖着紫绒布的托盘。
菲利普很享受这种万众瞩目的感觉，他无视了周围人复杂的目光，摇着扇子，仪态万方地踱步到瑟薇娅面前，行了一个夸张的屈膝礼。
“我亲爱的公主殿下，”他用一种甜得发腻的声音说道，“二皇子殿下听闻您即将为王室分忧，远赴北境苦寒之地，心中是万分不忍。他特意命我前来，送上一份薄礼，以表兄长对妹妹的拳拳关爱之心。”
说着，他对着侍从使了个眼色。侍从上前一步，掀开了绒布。
托盘里放着的，既非珠宝，也非奇物，而是一件做工粗糙的熊皮大氅，旁边还附赠了一本破旧的《北境异闻录》。
在场宾客非富即贵，哪里看不出这礼物背后的潜台词。这几乎是在公开暗示，公主此去，就是从文明世界流放到蛮荒之地。
铁岩将军的拳头已经捏紧了，安德鲁的脸色也变得铁青。
菲利普却仿佛没看到众人的反应，他用镶宝石的扇子半掩着唇，声音带着一种刻意雕琢的关切：“二皇子殿下说了，要真正融入一片土地，就要先拥抱它的灵魂。北境的风雪，可不识王都的丝绸。唯有这般质朴坚韧之物，才与那片土地……以及，某些源自那里的坚韧血脉，更为契合，不是吗？”
瑟薇娅脸上的笑容没有变化，只是眼神冷了下来。她看着菲利普，声音依旧平静柔和：“二哥费心了。这份‘厚礼’，确实饱含深意。我定会原封不动地呈送给父王，让他也看看二哥对王室血脉与疆土风俗之间联系的独到见解。父王总说兄长们于国事上还需多加历练，想必看到二哥如此体贴入微的考量，定会深感欣慰。”
content_en:
Yinhui City, Wang Family Iris Manor.
In the banquet hall, the crystal lamp illuminated the wine glasses and the guests' fancy clothes. The aroma of food floated in the air, mixed with the smell of business.
Serviya was holding a wine glass and walking through the crowd with a perfect smile on her face.
"President Mars, the value of the minerals in the north is much higher than the old report from the Ministry of Finance. Coupled with Professor Logaris' new smelting technology, you have an idea of how much the return can be."
Serviya said to a fat man, who was a new businessman who made a fortune by reselling magic parts.
President Mars's cheeks trembled slightly.
"Your Highness, just ask! Your business is the future of us businessmen! Funds are not a problem!"
Serviya nodded, turned and walked towards a young noble.
"Andrew, I understand your concerns."
"The place where my father and my two good brothers disdain is exactly where I can take root."
Andrew was one of the few new-style nobles who supported Serviya. He frowned: "Your Highness, the North is different from the King's Capital. The old Duke's old subordinates, I'm afraid..."
"I know." Serviya interrupted him, "That's why I need you."
Her voice was not loud, but Andrew stood up straight in an instant, and his eyes became different.
"Your Highness!" A figure in white robe appeared beside her quietly.
It's Aurora.
"Why, Her Royal Highness the Saint is also interested in the common affairs of us mortals?" Serviya made a joke.
Aurora had a holy smile on her face, but her words were very real: "I have already taken care of the Holy See Senate for you. However, the Judgment Army is its own system and is not under my control. You must be careful."
Serviya understood.
"Thank you."
"There is no need to talk about this between us." Aurora handed her a glass of juice.
Serviya was about to ask again when a burly general strode over.
Former deputy commander of the Northern Army, General Tie Yan.
"Your Highness Princess!" The general's voice was loud, "You are going to the north to create a great cause, how can you leave an old guy like me in the royal capital!"
"The general is joking, you are the pillar of the kingdom, I can't move you."
"Your Highness, don't say that!" General Tieyan looked excited, "I heard that the third generation magic armor designed by Professor Logaris has been distributed to your guards! I have been craving for that thing for a long time! You can smash the troll's head into its own chest with one punch! It's so powerful!"
He rubbed his hands together, looking less like a senior general and more like a child who saw a new toy.
"As long as Your Highness allows me to touch that new suit of armor, let alone the northern border, there will be mountains of swords and seas of fire, and I will join you!"
Serviya smiled.
That guy in Logaris could always bring her some surprises in unexpected places.
At this moment, the music in the banquet hall was interrupted by a high-pitched announcement from the door.
"His Royal Highness the Second Prince, Viscount Philippe has arrived——! On the order of His Highness the Second Prince, I present a gift to Her Highness Princess Serviya who is about to go to the North!"
This announcement caused the entire banquet hall to become silent instantly. All eyes were turned to the door.
A young man with powdered face and purple dress came in, shaking a jeweled fan. It was none other than the second prince's most favored jester, Viscount Philip. Behind him were two attendants, respectfully holding a tray covered with purple velvet cloth.
Philip enjoyed this feeling of being in the spotlight. He ignored the complicated looks of the people around him, waved his fan, walked up to Serviya in a graceful manner, and made an exaggerated curtsey.
"My dear Princess," he said in a voice that was cloyingly sweet, "His Royal Highness the Second Prince couldn't bear to hear that you were going to the bitter cold land in the north to take care of the royal family's worries. He specially ordered me to come and give you a small gift to show your brother's love for his sister."
As he spoke, he winked at the attendant. The attendant stepped forward and lifted the flannel.
What was placed on the tray was neither jewelry nor rare objects, but a roughly made bearskin cloak, and a shabby "History of the Northern Territory" was attached next to it.
The guests present were either rich or noble, so the subtext behind this gift could not be discerned. This is almost a public hint that the princess is being exiled from the civilized world to a barbaric land.
General Tieyan's fists were clenched, and Andrew's face turned livid.
Philip didn't seem to see everyone's reaction. He half-covered his lips with a fan inlaid with gems, and said with a deliberately crafted concern in his voice: "His Royal Highness the Second Prince said that in order to truly integrate into a land, you must first embrace its soul. The wind and snow in the north do not recognize the silk of the royal capital. Only something as simple and tough as this is more in line with that land... and some of the tough blood that originated there, isn't it?"
The smile on Serviya's face did not change, but her eyes became cold. She looked at Philip, her voice still calm and soft: "Second brother, you have taken the trouble. This 'gift' is indeed full of profound meaning. I will definitely present it to my father intact, so that he can also see the second brother's unique insights into the connection between the royal blood and the customs of the territory. My father always said that the brothers need more experience in state affairs. I must be deeply gratified to see the second brother's considerate consideration."
